newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's forint ends slightly down vs dlr.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's forint ends slightly down vs dlr.

text.p: Hungary's forint closed slightly lower versus the dollar as the U.S. currency extended its gains against the mark in the afternoon, dealers said.
"(The forint) eased slightly due to the change of the dollar/mark," said Corvinbank's Csaba Fonad.
The forint finished at 170.36/40, down from 170.30/35 in early afternoon deals. Trading was slow, dealers said.
The forint floats against a currency basket made up 70 percent of the mark and 30 percent of the dollar.
The mark was in focus on the currency futures market of the Budapest Commodity Exchange. The German currency eased for almost all maturities.
Most dollar futures remained stable, while two maturities firmed 30 fillers. Most yen futures closed lower.
